data.title: Bugfix: Depth Gradient Display Not Working

epic.spec:
# Bugfix: Depth Gradient Display Not Working

## Problem

The "Display → Depth Gradient" toggle exists in the UI but does nothing. When enabled, stations and shots continue to display section-based colors instead of depth-based colors. The toggle state persists correctly, but the actual rendering logic to apply depth colors was never implemented.

**Root cause**: MapCanvas doesn't pass `showDepthGradient` to SurveyLayer, and SurveyLayer always uses section colors without any conditional logic for depth mode.

## Approach

### 1. Wire up depth gradient toggle to SurveyLayer
- Extract `showDepthGradient` in MapCanvas (follow pattern at L598-614 for showShotData)
- Add `setShowDepthGradient(show: boolean, minDepth: number, maxDepth: number)` to SurveyLayer
- Store depth range to avoid recalculation during feature building
- Call `this.update()` when toggle changes

### 2. Pass depth range to SurveyLayer
**Decision**: Pass depth range via setter method (NOT modifying update() signature)
```typescript
// In MapCanvas useEffect:
surveyLayerRef.current.setShowDepthGradient(
  showDepthGradient,
  stats?.min_depth ?? 0,
  stats?.max_depth ?? 50
);
```

### 3. Modify color computation in SurveyLayer.update()
- When depth gradient enabled, compute colors using `getDepthColor()` instead of section color
- Apply to: stations, shots (including virtual), station labels, shot data labels
- Exclude: loop closures (keep error-severity colors), merges (keep distinct styling), ghost previews

### 4. Update getDepthColor() utility
- Modify to use HSL interpolation (shortest hue path) instead of RGB
- Handle edge cases: NaN depth, division by zero (when min===max)
- Colors: shallow=#00bfff (light blue) → deep=#ff4444 (red)
- Clamp depth values outside range to nearest boundary

### 5. Special cases
- **Zero datum stations**: Gold border (#ffd700) with depth-colored fill
- **z=0**: Treated as surface level, gets shallowest color
- **min_depth === max_depth**: Return shallow color, legend shows single value
- **Negative depths**: Clamp to shallow color
- **Selection/hover highlights**: Unaffected, use existing highlight colors

### 6. Add depth legend component
- New `DepthLegend.tsx` React component in MapCanvas
- Position: `bottom: 50px; left: 10px;` (10px above scale bar)
- Format: vertical SVG gradient bar (16px wide × 80px tall) with min/max depth labels
- Semi-transparent dark background: `rgba(0,0,0,0.7)`, 4px border-radius
- Labels: 11px white text with text-shadow for contrast
- Respects project measurement units (m/ft)
- Single-depth case: shows single value "(Flat cave)" with solid color
- **Accessibility**: Add `role="img"` and `aria-label` for screen readers
- Hidden when depth gradient toggle is OFF

### 7. Export color mode option
- Add dropdown to ExportDialog: "Section Colors" / "Depth Gradient"
- Default: Section Colors
- Implementation: Use async/await to avoid visual flash:
  1. Store current showDepthGradient value
  2. Set desired mode
  3. Wait for SurveyLayer to update (requestAnimationFrame)
  4. Capture map
  5. Restore original mode
- **Legend in export**: Yes, capture entire map container including overlay

### 8. Keyboard shortcut infrastructure
- Add depth gradient toggle to keyboard shortcuts config
- ID: `toggleDepthGradient`
- No default binding
- Action: `useUIStore.getState().toggleDisplay('showDepthGradient')`

## Edge Cases

| Case | Handling |
|------|----------|
| All stations at z=0 | All get shallow color, legend shows "0.0m (Flat)" |
| min_depth === max_depth | Return shallow color, legend shows single value |
| Negative depths (z<0) | Clamp to shallow color |
| NaN depth values | Skip depth color, use section color fallback |
| stats not yet loaded | Default range 0-50m until stats available |
| Empty project | Legend hidden, no features to color |
| Real-time import | New stations use depth colors immediately (update() called) |
| Very large projects | Use loops not Math.min/max spread (memory pitfall) |

## Error Handling

- `getDepthColor()` validates inputs: isFinite check before interpolation
- Division by zero guarded: if (maxDepth === minDepth) return shallowColor
- Invalid hex colors: fall back to defaults
- MapLibre expression errors: log warning, don't crash

## Quick commands
```bash
# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Unit tests
pnpm test

# Playwright tests
pnpm test:ui
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Toggling "Depth Gradient" ON colors stations/shots/labels by depth using HSL interpolation
- [ ] Toggling OFF instantly reverts to section colors
- [ ] Zero datum stations have gold border with depth-colored fill
- [ ] Loop closures and merges keep their distinct styling
- [ ] Depth legend appears 10px above scale bar when enabled, hidden when disabled
- [ ] Legend shows project's min/max depth in correct units
- [ ] Legend accessible with ARIA label
- [ ] Single-depth projects show "(Flat cave)" indicator
- [ ] Export dialog has color mode dropdown defaulting to section colors
- [ ] Export captures legend when depth mode selected
- [ ] Keyboard shortcut configurable (no default binding)
- [ ] Unit tests for getDepthColor() HSL interpolation
- [ ] Playwright tests for toggle behavior and legend visibility
- [ ] WebdriverIO tests for cross-browser compatibility
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] All existing tests pass

## References

### Key Files
- `src/store/uiStore.ts:L152,L226,L358,L416` - showDepthGradient toggle state
- `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:L598-614` - Display toggle sync pattern
- `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx:L704-980` - update() method for coloring
- `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx:L601-625` - Setter method patterns
- `src/utils/colors.ts:L52-68` - Current getDepthColor() implementation
- `src/components/Dialogs/ExportDialog.tsx:L126-163` - Export options pattern
- `src/types/project.ts:L170-179` - ProjectStats with min_depth/max_depth

### Architecture Notes
- Display toggle flow: uiStore → MapCanvas useEffect → SurveyLayer setter
- Color computation: Precompute in update() for performance
- Scale bar uses MapLibre ScaleControl at 'bottom-left' (L622)

### Memory Pitfalls
- Use loops not Math.min/max spread for large arrays (overflow risk)
- Check is_finite() before normalizing depth values

# fn-5-jef.2 Modify getDepthColor() to use HSL interpolation

## Description
Modify `getDepthColor()` in `src/utils/colors.ts` to use HSL interpolation instead of RGB.

## Current Implementation (L52-68)
Currently uses linear RGB interpolation which can produce muddy intermediate colors.

## New Implementation
Use HSL color space interpolation with shortest hue path:

```typescript
export function getDepthColor(
  depth: number,
  shallowColor: string,  // Default: '#00bfff' (light blue)
  deepColor: string,     // Default: '#ff4444' (red)
  shallowDepth: number,  // Default: 0
  deepDepth: number      // Default: project max depth
): string {
  // Clamp depth to range
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (depth - shallowDepth) / (deepDepth - shallowDepth)));

  // Convert hex to HSL
  const shallowHSL = hexToHSL(shallowColor);
  const deepHSL = hexToHSL(deepColor);

  // Interpolate in HSL space (shortest hue path)
  const h = interpolateHue(shallowHSL.h, deepHSL.h, t);
  const s = shallowHSL.s + (deepHSL.s - shallowHSL.s) * t;
  const l = shallowHSL.l + (deepHSL.l - shallowHSL.l) * t;

  return hslToHex(h, s, l);
}
```

## Helper Functions to Add
- `hexToHSL(hex: string): { h: number, s: number, l: number }`
- `hslToHex(h: number, s: number, l: number): string`
- `interpolateHue(h1: number, h2: number, t: number): number` - takes shortest path around color wheel

## Notes
- Keep existing function signature for backward compatibility
- Handle edge case: if deepDepth === shallowDepth, return shallowColor
- Default colors: shallow=#00bfff (light blue), deep=#ff4444 (red)
## Acceptance
- [ ] `getDepthColor()` uses HSL interpolation with shortest hue path
- [ ] Helper functions `hexToHSL()`, `hslToHex()`, `interpolateHue()` added
- [ ] Edge case: same shallow/deep depth returns shallow color
- [ ] Function signature unchanged for backward compatibility
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-5-jef.3 Implement depth-based coloring in SurveyLayer.update()

## Description
Implement depth-based coloring logic in `SurveyLayer.update()`.

## File: `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx`

### Station Feature Building (L770-790)
Current code at ~L772-773:
```typescript
color: section?.color ?? '#ffffff',
```
Change to:
```typescript
const stationDepth = station.coordinates.z;
const color = this.showDepthGradient && isFinite(stationDepth)
  ? getDepthColor(stationDepth, '#00bfff', '#ff4444', this.depthRange.min, this.depthRange.max)
  : section?.color ?? '#ffffff';
```

### Shot Feature Building (L723-740)
Current code at ~L735:
```typescript
color: section.color,
```
Change to:
```typescript
const fromDepth = fromStation.coordinates.z;
const toDepth = toStation.coordinates.z;
const avgDepth = (fromDepth + toDepth) / 2;
const color = this.showDepthGradient && isFinite(avgDepth)
  ? getDepthColor(avgDepth, '#00bfff', '#ff4444', this.depthRange.min, this.depthRange.max)
  : section.color;
```

### Station Labels (~L800-820)
Apply same depth color to station index labels when enabled.

### Shot Data Labels
Apply same depth color to shot azimuth/length/depth labels when enabled.

### Unchanged Elements
- Loop closures (L223-235): Keep error-severity coloring
- Merges (L193-221): Keep distinct styling
- Ghost previews: Keep ghost styling

## Imports
Add at top of file:
```typescript
import { getDepthColor } from '@/utils/colors';
```

## Performance Note
Use existing loop structure - avoid creating large arrays for Math.min/max (memory overflow risk on large projects).
## Files to Modify

### `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx`
Modify `update()` method (L704-980) to conditionally use depth colors.

## Implementation

### 1. Get depth range from project stats
```typescript
// In update(), get min/max depth from project
const minDepth = this.project?.stats?.min_depth ?? 0;
const maxDepth = this.project?.stats?.max_depth ?? 50;
```

### 2. Modify station feature building (L770-790)
```typescript
// Current: color: section?.color ?? '#ffffff'
// New:
const color = this.showDepthGradient
  ? getDepthColor(station.coordinates.z, '#00bfff', '#ff4444', minDepth, maxDepth)
  : section?.color ?? '#ffffff';
```

### 3. Modify shot feature building (L732-740)
```typescript
// Current: color: section.color
// New:
const avgDepth = (fromStation.coordinates.z + toStation.coordinates.z) / 2;
const color = this.showDepthGradient
  ? getDepthColor(avgDepth, '#00bfff', '#ff4444', minDepth, maxDepth)
  : section.color;
```

### 4. Modify station labels (around L800-820)
Apply depth color to station index labels when enabled.

### 5. Modify shot data labels
Apply depth color to shot azimuth/length/depth labels when enabled.

### 6. Keep excluded elements unchanged
- Loop closures (keep error-severity colors)
- Merges (keep distinct styling)
- Ghost previews (keep ghost styling)

- Virtual shots use same depth coloring as regular shots
- z=0 is treated as surface level (shallowest color)

# fn-5-jef.4 Handle zero datum stations with gold border + depth fill

## Description
Handle zero datum stations with gold border and depth-colored fill.

## Current Behavior
Zero datum stations (entry points) have:
- Larger radius (8 vs 4)
- Gold fill color (#ffd700)
- Black stroke

## New Behavior with Depth Gradient
When `showDepthGradient` enabled:
- Keep larger radius (8)
- Fill: depth-based color (from getDepthColor)
- Stroke: gold (#ffd700) instead of black
- Stroke width: increase to 2-3px for visibility

## Files to Modify

### `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx`

#### In `initializeLayers()` (L249-271)
Update stations layer paint to support dynamic stroke color:
```typescript
paint: {
  'circle-radius': ['case', ['get', 'isZeroDatum'], 8, 4],
  'circle-color': ['get', 'color'],  // Already dynamic
  'circle-stroke-width': ['case', ['get', 'isZeroDatum'], 2, 1],
  'circle-stroke-color': ['get', 'strokeColor'],  // New property
}
```

#### In `update()` station feature building
Add `strokeColor` property:
```typescript
const isZeroDatum = station.is_zero_datum ?? false;
const strokeColor = this.showDepthGradient && isZeroDatum ? '#ffd700' : '#000000';
// Feature properties:
strokeColor,
```

## Visual Result
- Normal stations: depth color fill, black border
- Zero datum stations: depth color fill, gold border (stands out as entry point)
## Acceptance

- [ ] Zero datum stations have depth-colored fill when depth gradient on
- [ ] Normal stations keep black stroke
- [ ] Stroke width increased for zero datum visibility

# fn-5-jef.5 Create DepthLegend component

## Description
Create DepthLegend component that shows depth color gradient with min/max labels.

## New File: `src/components/Map/DepthLegend.tsx`

### Props
```typescript
interface DepthLegendProps {
  minDepth: number;
  maxDepth: number;
  shallowColor?: string;  // Default: '#00bfff'
  deepColor?: string;     // Default: '#ff4444'
  unit: 'm' | 'ft';
  visible: boolean;
}
```

### Position & Style
```css
position: absolute;
bottom: 50px;  /* 10px above scale bar (scale bar height ~40px) */
left: 10px;
background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
border-radius: 4px;
padding: 8px;
```

### SVG Gradient Bar (Vertical)
```tsx
<svg width="16" height="80" role="img" aria-label={`Depth scale: ${minDepth}${unit} to ${maxDepth}${unit}`}>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="depth-gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stopColor={shallowColor} />
      <stop offset="100%" stopColor={deepColor} />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="16" height="80" fill="url(#depth-gradient)" rx="2" />
</svg>
```

### Labels
- Top label: min depth (shallow) - e.g., "0.0m"
- Bottom label: max depth (deep) - e.g., "45.2m"
- Style: `font-size: 11px; color: white; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);`

### Special Cases
- **minDepth === maxDepth**: Show single value with "(Flat)" indicator, solid color bar
- **not visible**: Return null (don't render)

### Accessibility
- `role="img"` on SVG
- `aria-label` with depth range description

## Integration in MapCanvas
Add after scale bar area:
```tsx
{showDepthGradient && stats && (
  <DepthLegend
    minDepth={stats.min_depth}
    maxDepth={stats.max_depth}
    unit={config?.measurement_unit ?? 'm'}
    visible={showDepthGradient}
  />
)}
```
## Component Specification

### Location
`src/components/Map/DepthLegend.tsx`

### Props
```typescript
interface DepthLegendProps {
  minDepth: number;
  maxDepth: number;
  shallowColor: string;  // Default: '#00bfff'
  deepColor: string;     // Default: '#ff4444'
  unit: 'm' | 'ft';      // From project config
  visible: boolean;      // Controlled by showDepthGradient toggle
}
```

### Visual Design
- Position: bottom-left corner, above scale bar (CSS: `bottom: 40px; left: 10px`)
- Size: 16px wide × 80px tall gradient bar
- Background: semi-transparent dark (`rgba(0,0,0,0.7)`, rounded corners)
- Padding: 8px
- Total size with labels: ~40px wide × 100px tall

### SVG Gradient Bar
```tsx
<svg width="16" height="80">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="depth-gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stopColor={shallowColor} />
      <stop offset="100%" stopColor={deepColor} />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="16" height="80" fill="url(#depth-gradient)" rx="2" />
</svg>
```

### Labels
- Top label: min depth (shallow) - e.g., "0.0m"
- Bottom label: max depth (deep) - e.g., "45.2m"
- Font: 11px, white, monospace for alignment
- Match project measurement unit

### Special Cases
- If minDepth === maxDepth: show single value, solid color bar
- If not visible: return null (don't render)

## Integration in MapCanvas
Add DepthLegend as sibling to existing overlays, conditionally rendered when showDepthGradient is true.

- [ ] DepthLegend component created at `src/components/Map/DepthLegend.tsx`
- [ ] SVG gradient bar 16×80px rendered correctly
